testcase.name: a reserved snapshot promoted onto the undo slot is detected by getPreRestoreBackupFile()
getPreMigrationBackupFile returns the file when present and null when absent()
a reserved snapshot is a self-contained SQLite copy at the live schema()
deletePreRestoreBackup removes the file when present()
deletePreRestoreBackup is a no-op when no file exists()
peekSnapshotSchemaVersion matches currentSchemaVersion for fresh capture()
rollback transaction sequence swaps live db with preserved contents and consumes file()
preserveDbBeforeMigration runs wal_checkpoint via direct SQLite()
a stale promoting file from a crashed promotion is discarded, never promoted()
pre_migration and pre_restore slots have independent lifecycles()
validateSnapshotForRestore returns BackupTooNew when source schema is newer()
preserveDbBeforeMigration returns null when no live db file exists()
second captureSnapshot reflects only entities present at second capture()
validateSnapshotForRestore with non-SQLite source returns CorruptedBackup()
liveDatabaseFile resolves to the app database path()
promotion COPIES - the journal-named reservation survives with its exact bytes()
